---
title: "Install, customize, and update"
---

## Install this checkpoint

Askr's public format is `askr-html`. Quarto's GitHub installer resolves tags
and branches; a commit SHA is not a supported `@` modifier. After the
repository is renamed to `arfiligol/askr`:

```bash
quarto add arfiligol/askr@develop
```

Until that rename, the same tree is:

```bash
quarto add arfiligol/quarto-design-kit@develop
```

Then select the format in a consumer `_quarto.yml`:

```yaml
format:
  askr-html:
    toc: true
    code-copy: true
```

The installed copy belongs under the consumer's tracked `_extensions` folder,
at `_extensions/arfiligol/askr`. Askr does not fetch fonts, icons, or styles
from a CDN.

## v0.2.1

Release `v0.2.1` was published as `qdk-html` from `arfiligol/quarto-design-kit`.
That install line is unchanged:

```bash
quarto add arfiligol/quarto-design-kit@v0.2.1
```

It still installs `qdk-html` at `_extensions/arfiligol/qdk`.

## Override tokens in the consumer

Create a consumer-owned Sass file, for example `styles.scss`, and list it after
the format theme. This preserves one Kit token authority while making the
consumer's explicit final override visible:

```yaml
format:
  askr-html:
    theme:
      light: [default, _extensions/arfiligol/askr/qdk.scss, styles.scss]
      dark: [default, _extensions/arfiligol/askr/qdk.scss, _extensions/arfiligol/askr/qdk-dark.scss, styles.scss]
```

```scss
/* Consumer-owned final override: change only a declared Askr token. */
/*-- scss:rules --*/
:root { --qdk-link: #2D5E85; }
```

Render the consumer and inspect the resulting CSS to verify its final token
value. Do not edit a copy inside `_extensions/arfiligol/askr`; reinstall the
reviewed tag instead.

## Update

Choose a new version tag only after reviewing its provenance and
rendering the consumer. Replace the installed extension through `quarto add`
with that tag, commit the resulting `_extensions` change in the consumer, and
repeat its own validation. The installed directory and its checked-in content
are the consumer's dependency pin.

## Search

Askr styles Quarto's overlay search. It does not add another index. Turn the
control on in the consumer website:

```yaml
website:
  search:
    location: navbar
    type: overlay
```

At 1280px and wider the button sits on the right, immediately left of the
theme toggle, and the header stays one row. Below that width it moves to the
left so the right side of the bar does not wrap.

## Figures that follow the toggle

A cell can emit a light output and a dark output. Quarto shows the one that matches `body.quarto-dark`. Put the light output first:

```python
#| renderings: [light, dark]
```

Draw or display the light figure, then the dark figure. With `askr-html` and `theme-toggle`, the dark stylesheet carries `data-mode="dark"`, and the toggle adds `quarto-dark` to `body`. Do not set `data-mode` from the page. The Figures page in this gallery renders a pair of swatches this way.
